title: How many NFL Scorigamis in the 2026-27 regular season?
description:
In sports, a Scorigami is a scoring combination that has never before occurred in a sport or league's history.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the number of NFL Scorigamis that occur during the 2026-27 NFL regular season equals or exceeds the listed number. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The 2026-27 NFL regular season covers all games from Week 1 through Week 18. Each game whose final score is a Scorigami counts as one Scorigami toward the total, including games played before this market opened. If two or more games in the same week produce Scorigamis, each counts separately toward the total. Preseason and postseason games, including Super Bowl LXI, will not count toward the total.

This market may resolve to "Yes" as soon as the listed number of Scorigamis has occurred.

If any 2026-27 NFL regular season game is canceled, or is postponed beyond February 14, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve based on the final scores of all completed regular season games.

The primary resolution source for this market is official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/scores/), however other sites tracking Scorigami may be used (nflscorigami.com, twitter.com/NFL_Scorigami).

title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Last Unbeaten Team
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that remains without a single loss the longest during the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

Ties do not count as losses.

If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to be the last team remaining without a loss, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

If multiple teams suffer their first loss on the same day, or if multiple teams finish the 2026-27 NFL regular season without a loss, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team that played the most games before recording its first loss, regardless of the number of ties recorded by those teams.

If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with the greater strength of victory in all games, and then the tied team with the greater strength of schedule in all games, as those terms are used in the NFL's official tie-breaking procedures (https://www.nfl.com/standings/tie-breaking-procedures). If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team whose full team name, as listed in this market, comes first alphabetically. The "Other" option will not be considered in these tie-breaks.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed after January 24, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the team that remained without a loss the longest cannot be determined within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

title: What will the announcers say during the Falcons vs Saints game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official ESPN announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Atlanta Falcons vs New Orleans Saints game on ESPN, scheduled for October 5, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "ESPN announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

The resolution source for this market is the national ESPN telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

title: Bills vs. Rams - Highest Scoring Quarter
description: Highest scoring quarter markets for Bills vs. Rams.

markets.question: Bills vs. Rams: Highest Scoring Quarter - Q1
markets.description: In the upcoming NFL football game between Bills and Rams, scheduled for October 12, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET: This market is one outcome in a neg-risk group covering the four quarters of regulation plus "Other". This market will resolve to "Yes" if the first quarter is the quarter in which the most total points are scored by both teams combined. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". Only points scored in the four regulation quarters count; overtime is not included. If two or more quarters tie for the most points scored, or if no points are scored in the game, the "Other" outcome resolves "Yes". All outcomes are based on the official NFL game book as published on NFL.com. Exactly one outcome in the group resolves "Yes". If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, the "Other" outcome resolves "Yes".

title: Fantasy Football: 2026-27 Week 5 Overall Points Leader (PPR)
description:
This market will resolve to the player that finishes Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season as the highest-scoring player under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 5 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more players are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 5, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player whose last name comes first alphabetically.

If the highest-scoring player in Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is not a listed player, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past October 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official Week 5 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

This market will resolve to the team defense and special teams (D/ST) unit that finishes Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season as the highest-scoring D/ST under the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 5 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more units are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 5, this market will resolve in favor of the tied unit whose team name comes first alphabetically.

If the highest-scoring D/ST in Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is not a listed unit, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 5 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past October 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official Week 5 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).
